headline: Brunnr-Code can review this change before you call it done.
reason: Review can help detect execution issues in these changes.
value: Reviewing takes a little longer and makes the result safer.

choices.label: Review this change
choices.effect: Reviews only this change; later medium- or high-risk changes ask again, and delivery needs separate approval.
choices.invocation: brunnr-code review start --contract brunnr-code.review-integration/v1 --cwd /repo --target sha256:29f4fd5a86f08b4a2b8ecb556d1bea4851824fdaa4a95e6efbe70bc1738bbd0d --target-evidence v1:current-changes:workspace:3e21a205dd9b55021aeae87965092623807e455f:556e838994d4e5669ffafda7b72226598bc38297:sha256:1cb68b191ea0337b5335de2c6dbbbb470129826a48bb0881bd87952316eaef1a --projection workspace --lineage review-consent-fixture --consent granted

choices.label: Skip this time
choices.effect: Skips only this change; no review record is created, and future reviews stay enabled.
choices.invocation: brunnr-code review start --contract brunnr-code.review-integration/v1 --cwd /repo --target sha256:29f4fd5a86f08b4a2b8ecb556d1bea4851824fdaa4a95e6efbe70bc1738bbd0d --target-evidence v1:current-changes:workspace:3e21a205dd9b55021aeae87965092623807e455f:556e838994d4e5669ffafda7b72226598bc38297:sha256:1cb68b191ea0337b5335de2c6dbbbb470129826a48bb0881bd87952316eaef1a --projection workspace --lineage review-consent-fixture --consent declined

off_path.note: To turn reviews off for good, run 'brunnr-code review mode disable'.
